description: This file defines a utility class 'DateUtil' for date-related operations such as formatting dates, generating timestamps, parsing date strings, and manipulating date objects within a Java web application.

classes.name: DateUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for date formatting, parsing, and manipulation, as well as instance methods to process posted date parameters.

methods.name: generateTimeStamp
methods.description: Generates a timestamp string in 'yyyyMMddHHmmSS' format representing the current moment.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a given Date object into a string using the default date format.

methods.name: formatYear
methods.description: Formats a given Date object into a year-only string.

methods.name: formatLongDate
methods.description: Formats a given Date object into a long date string, including day, date, month, year, time, and timezone.

methods.name: formatDateMonthString
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string with pattern 'yyyy-MM-dd'.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Parses a date string into a Date object using the default date format.

methods.name: addDaysToCurrentDate
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current date plus a specified number of days.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the current date and time.

methods.name: getPresentDate
methods.description: Returns the current date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getPresentYear
methods.description: Returns the current year as a string.

methods.name: processPostedDates
methods.description: Processes 'startdate' and 'enddate' parameters from an HttpServletRequest to set internal date fields.
